title: Differential Context v1
description: Structured result of computing a differential (diff) context between two git references. Supports PR, push, dispatch, local, and CI modes. Never returns raw strings; all results are typed objects that distinguish git failures from empty diffs.

mode.description: The computation mode that produced this context.

base_tip.description: The base branch or commit reference (e.g. 'main', 'origin/main').

event_head.description: The head commit for the triggering event.

merge_base.description: The computed merge-base commit SHA between base_tip and event_head. null when computation failed or is inapplicable.

tested_sha.description: The commit SHA under test (e.g. from CI --tested-sha).

zero_before.description: True when the push before-sha is all-zeros (new branch / force-push to new ref).

empty_tree_hash.description: The git empty-tree hash (4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf892b69e8b9e75fe), used as merge-base when zero_before is True.

git_error.description: True if any git command failed with a non-zero exit code.

git_error_details.description: Details about git command failures, present only when git_error is True.

stderr.description: Standard error output from the failed command.

is_empty_diff.description: True when the diff between merge_base and head is empty (no changes). Distinct from git_error.

changed_files.description: List of changed file paths (relative) when a non-empty diff exists. null when diff computation failed.

diff_raw.description: Raw unified diff output. null when diff computation failed or is empty.

local_head.description: HEAD commit SHA for local mode.

local_dirty.description: True when local worktree has uncommitted changes.
